d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Southeast Africa Digital Sales team is responsible for implementing a new remote sales coverage model to work with our mid-market clients through digital channels. The team will use AI and automation, digital marketing and analytics to help clients achieve their business objectives and enabling Visa to accelerate growth.
q: Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of experience in B2B tech sales or in financial services sales, including a minimum of 3 years in a team lead capacity.
Originally from / experience working across SEA markets.
Proven ability to navigate complex sales cycles and manage large, complex deal negotiations.
Strong technical skills and ability to understand complex technological solutions and business issues.
Experience in using reporting tools and features (e.g., MSD, PowerBI, Tableau) to create actionable insights.
Ability to work independently as well as collaborate within a team environment.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills to influence senior-level clients and internal stakeholders.
Multicultural sensitivity and interpersonal relationship management skills.
Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, including risk, client experience, payment security, transaction processing, and regulatory requirements.
Proven track record in field sales or related role.
Experience selling complex and technical products and services.
Strong executive presence and ability to interact at the C-level with client organizations.
Experience in eCommerce, merchant, and payments industries.
Ability to generate organizational momentum through creative and innovative solutions.
Experience in leading teams through change and adopting new tools, processes, or strategies.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
